payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about various post-processing approaches applied to translation outputs, including rescoring, unknown word replacement, and restoring special tokens.

claims.text: Post-processing includes rescoring translation candidates using a Czech language model to improve fluency.
Unknown word replacement (UWR) is applied to reduce the impact of out-of-vocabulary words in translations.
Restoration of special tokens like <NUMBER> and <DATE> to their original values is performed in post-processing.
A recaser is used to convert translations to their correct case forms after processing.
